messages:
Nora (Marketing): Hey team — creative ask for the Q2 launch bench narrative. Need: hero benchmark diagram (web + print), 2 webinar slides (context + key results), single-page PDF one-pager, 4 social tiles (2 sq + 2 story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. Goal: publish assets by Tue EOD (2026-04-07). Can someone own and call out blockers?

Diego (Design): I can take. Quick clarifications: which metrics to highlight and any logo usage rules? Also file specs please.

Nora (Marketing): Prioritize p50/p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens. Minimal headlines only. Logos: only Legal-approved whitelist. Specs: hero web PNG 1400x800, hero print PDF 8.5x11, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920, email header 600x200. SVG must include element ids for mapping.

Priya (Product): Uploaded bench CSV to Drive: key numbers p50=41ms, p95=122ms, cost=$0.007/1k tokens. Added README: "Measured in our internal testbeds; not an SLA."

Sam (Marketing Ops): For HubSpot mapping, include element ids like id=form-email id=seg-webinar id=sfdc-lead. I'll provide the mapping CSV after I see ids. Also need SVG nodes labeled for campaign UTM flows.

Diego (Design): Timeline: WIP Mon morning (hero + slides first), final by Tue 14:00 PT. Will export EN masters with editable text layers for FR/DE localization and include an SVG with ids. Filenames: bench-hero-web.png, bench-hero-print.pdf, bench-webinar-1.pdf, bench-1pager.pdf, bench-social-1.png, bench-routing.svg.

Legal (Legal): Compliance note: do NOT use customer logos without explicit written approval. Partner logos ok if on approved whitelist. Avoid SLA-like wording; use qualifiers such as "benchmarked" or "measured in our testbeds." Priya, ensure README wording matches.

Nora (Marketing): Thanks — priority order: 1) hero + webinar slides 2) routing SVG 3) 1-pager 4) social tiles + email header. Diego, tag me when WIP is up and i'll run a brand sweep.

Diego (Design): Will share figma WIP link Mon 09:00 PT and upload exports to Drive when final. Ping here for copy tweaks.

Priya (Product): README updated per Legal.

Sam (Marketing Ops): I'll prep the HubSpot mapping CSV template so it's ready once the SVG ids exist.

Nora (Marketing): Great — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
